name: claudeconnect
notes: No more "Error 1101 Worker threw exception" right after an update. For a little while after an update, the part of the site that keeps your chats and settings could still be running the old version; pages now load anyway, and that part restarts into the new version as soon as it's used.
Settings changed in that moment either go through, or say the site is still switching and to try again in a few seconds, instead of silently not saving.
